campaign_b_slurry_origin_evidence_2026_0.architecture_trace: Stores: housing (physical capacity x fill, Phase 1A reconciliation). Planning: slurry_allocations rows (field, store, planned physical m3); lifecycle planned -> completed | cancelled via RPCs; an edit (update_planned_slurry_allocation) moves field/store/volume IN PLACE on the same id; recreate = new id. Neat evidence is per store. fieldPlannedRegulatoryNeatSlurry sums a field's active, non-not_suitable allocations; calculateNutrientPlan accepts ONE origin per field (plannedRegulatoryNeatSlurry.origin) and blocks PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED when it is absent. Callers: Nutrients screen and Scientific Evidence Report via buildSlurryRegulatoryContextFromRecords -> plannedRegulatoryNeatSlurryForNutrientPlan. Capture UI: /spreading/plan (SlurryPlanLifecycle).
campaign_b_slurry_origin_evidence_2026_0.chosen_scope: The planned allocation at one plan revision. New slurry_allocations.plan_revision (database-maintained: 1 on insert, +1 on any change of field_id/housing_id/volume_m3, pinned otherwise; completion and cancellation do not change it). A declaration stamps the revision, field, store and planned volume from the locked allocation row and applies only while all still match. The client sends the revision it saw; the database refuses a stale one (PLAN_CHANGED) and any declaration for a non-planned allocation (NOT_PLANNED).
rejected_alternatives: Store-level binary origin: a store can hold home-produced and imported slurry at once, and an import added later would silently make a permanent store answer false.
Allocation-level origin without a revision: an edit moves field/store/volume in place on the same id, so a declaration would silently survive a move (including a move away and back).
Deriving origin from store ownership, housing, grazing livestock on the herd record, allocation source, composition, volume or history: none of them is evidence of origin.

Splitting mixed slurry by allocation volume or store make-up: calculateNutrientPlan takes one origin per field and no audited contract splits it; no proportion is invented (STOP boundary, documented, not widened).
campaign_b_slurry_origin_evidence_2026_0.unknown_and_mixed: Declarations: home_produced_grazing_livestock | imported_organic_manure | mixed | unknown. Only the first two map to RegulatoryManureOrigin. mixed -> PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGIN_MIXED_SPLIT_NOT_ESTABLISHED; unknown -> PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGIN_DECLARED_UNKNOWN; several contributing plans with different known origins -> PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGINS_DIFFER_ACROSS_PLANS; contradictory ties -> conflicting PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGIN_TIED_DECLARATIONS_CONFLICT; no applicable declaration -> PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Each leaves plannedRegulatoryNeatSlurry.origin unset, so the NAP check stays BLOCKED PLANNED_MANURE_ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

Current applicable record = latest created_at among declarations matching the allocation's current revision and snapshot; equivalent ties collapse by id, contradictory ties conflict.
